papers.title: Mechanical Properties and Fatigue Life Estimation of Selective-Laser-Manufactured Ti6Al4V Alloys in a Comparison Between Annealing Treatment and Hot Isostatic Pressing
papers.abstract: Selective laser melting (SLM) offers a novel approach for manufacturing intricate structures, broadening the application of titanium alloy parts in the aerospace industry. After the build period, heat treatments of annealing (AT) and hot isostatic pressing (HIP) are often implemented, but a comparison of their mechanical performances based on the specimen orientation is still lacking. In this study, horizontally and vertically built Ti6Al4V SLM specimens that underwent the aforementioned treatments, together with their microstructural and defect characteristics, were, respectively, investigated using metallography and X-ray imaging. The mechanical properties and failure mechanism, via fracture analysis, were obtained. The critical factors influencing the mechanical properties and the correlation of the fatigue lives and failure origins were also estimated. The results demonstrate that the mechanical performances were determined by the α-phase morphology and defects, which included micropores and fewer large lack-of-fusion defects. Following the coarsening of the α phase, the strength decreased while the plasticity remained stable. With the discrepancy in the defect occurrence, anisotropy and scatter of the mechanical performances were introduced, which was significantly alleviated with HIP treatment. The fatigue failure origins were governed by defects and the α colony, which was composed of parallel α phases. Approximately linear relationships correlating fatigue lives with the X-parameter and maximum stress amplitude were, respectively, established in the AT and HIP states. The results provide an understanding of the technological significance of the evaluation of mechanical properties.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接比较了退火和热等静压两种后处理对SLM Ti6Al4V力学性能和疲劳寿命的影响，完全符合研究方向。
llm.why_not_core: 该论文未涉及其他后处理如喷丸、抛光或涂层，且未进行有限元或机器学习建模。

summary_zh.motivation: 比较退火和热等静压对SLM Ti6Al4V不同取向试样力学性能及疲劳寿命的影响。
summary_zh.method: 使用金相、X射线成像、拉伸和疲劳测试分析微观组织、缺陷及断裂机制。
summary_zh.result: 力学性能由α相形态和缺陷决定，HIP显著降低各向异性，疲劳寿命与X参数和应力幅呈线性关系。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试和断口分析验证了微观组织与性能的关系。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the effects of annealing and hot isostatic pressing on the mechanical properties and fatigue life of SLM Ti6Al4V alloys fabricated in different orientations.
summary_en.method: Metallography, X-ray imaging, tensile and fatigue tests, and fracture analysis were employed to characterize microstructure, defects, and failure mechanisms.
summary_en.result: Mechanical performance was governed by α-phase morphology and defects; HIP significantly alleviated anisotropy, and linear relationships were established between fatigue life and both the X-parameter and maximum stress amplitude.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing combined with microstructural and fractographic analysis validated the findings.

papers.title: Microstructural control across multiple length scales in additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V via cyclic heat treatments
papers.abstract: Ti-6Al-4V is a premier titanium alloy widely used across various industrial sectors, thanks to its versatile properties arising from diverse microstructures tailorable via thermomechanical processing (TMP). In contrast, Ti-6Al-4V made by laser powder-bed fusion (LPBF) additive manufacturing (AM) lacks the same microstructural diversity and precise in-process microstructural control, primarily due to rapid thermal cycling inherent to LPBF. In the as-built state, the microstructure predominantly comprises acicular α′ martensites within columnar prior-β grains, which often fails to achieve mechanical properties comparable to those obtained through TMP. This necessitates the use of post-heat treatments as a critical step to ensure superior and reliable mechanical performance. The present study explores cyclic heat treatment (CHT) as an effective strategy for AM-specific microstructural control across multiple length scales, including prior-β grains, primary α, and secondary α. By varying peak temperature, number of cycles, and cooling rate, the initial microstructure dominated by α′ martensite in columnar prior-β grains rapidly evolves into diverse microstructures comparable to those achieved via TMP. These include lamellar α+β in equiaxed prior-β grains, globular α in near-equiaxed prior-β grains, and bimodal microstructure comprising a mixture of globular α and lamellar α+β/acicular α’. The accelerated microstructural evolution driven by the repetitive α↔β phase transformations induced by CHT facilitates processes like epitaxial recrystallisation and α globularisation. The developed CHT protocol provides a framework for microstructural engineering, enabling mechanical property optimisation and supporting broader industrial adoption of LPBF Ti-6Al-4V.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了循环热处理对激光粉末床熔融Ti-6Al-4V微观结构的多尺度调控，直接关联后处理对力学性能的优化，符合L2方向要求。
llm.why_not_core: No explicit fatigue or tensile test results are reported in the abstract, though mechanical property optimization is claimed.

summary_zh.motivation: 增材制造Ti-6Al-4V缺乏热机械加工带来的微观结构多样性，需后热处理改善性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用循环热处理，通过改变峰值温度、循环次数和冷却速率调控多尺度微观结构。
summary_zh.result: 实现了类似热机械加工的多种微观结构，包括等轴β晶粒内的片层α+β、球化α及双态组织。
summary_zh.validation: 通过微观结构表征验证了循环热处理加速组织演化的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V lacks the microstructural diversity achievable by thermomechanical processing, necessitating post-heat treatments for improved mechanical performance.
summary_en.method: Cyclic heat treatments with varying peak temperature, number of cycles, and cooling rate are used to control microstructure across multiple length scales.
summary_en.result: Microstructures comparable to thermomechanically processed alloys, including lamellar α+β in equiaxed prior-β grains, globular α, and bimodal structures, are achieved.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization confirms accelerated evolution via repetitive α↔β phase transformations.
